name: local-live-captions
description: Firefox add-on that shows live English captions for any audio playing in a tab, using a local Whisper model.

scripts.start: npm run vendor && web-ext run --source-dir extension --browser-console
scripts.sign: npm run vendor && web-ext sign --source-dir extension --channel unlisted
scripts.test: node test/throttle.test.mjs && node test/downsampler.test.mjs && node test/settings.test.mjs && node test/engine.test.mjs && node test/transcript.test.mjs && node test/timeline.test.mjs
scripts.publish:amo: npm test && npm run build && npm run source && web-ext sign --source-dir extension --channel listed --upload-source-code web-ext-artifacts/source-$npm_package_version.zip --amo-metadata docs/amo/$npm_package_version.json --approval-timeout 0
